intro: Four moments that got me from a mechanical engineering degree to analysis work.

slides.label: May 2024
slides.title: Graduated Mechanical Engineering
slides.text: Finished BS Mechanical Engineering at the University of San Carlos, Cebu, in May 2024, after four years and a Dean's List citation along the way.

slides.label: Dec 2023
slides.title: Thesis: a pyrolysis reactor for oil-soaked cloth
slides.text: Auto repair shops throw away rags soaked in used engine oil, which is both a disposal problem and wasted fuel. With Kaye Antonnet R. Adolfo and Rhel Dhenissie C. Barina, under Dr. Edwin A. Carcasona, I designed and fabricated a pyrolysis reactor that heats those rags without oxygen so the oil comes back off as recoverable energy instead of going to landfill. We presented it at the 12th International Mechanical Engineering Research Conference in January 2024.
slides.imageAlt: The pyrolysis reactor built for the thesis

slides.label: Feb 2025
slides.title: Became a licensed Mechanical Engineer
slides.text: Passed the Mechanical Engineering licensure examination, becoming a Registered Mechanical Engineer.

slides.title: Joined AvePoint as a Business Analyst
slides.text: Started as a Junior Business Analyst at AvePoint Cebu, working on Electronic Document and Records Management Systems for enterprise clients.
